T: Trees, every one with a wooden sword stuck in it by a child.
U: The Kaldorium Maximus. The old pit wasn't loud enough, so Kaldor built this. You can hear it breathing.
8: The great gate of the Maximus. Every time you go in, the next champion on the ladder is waiting.
I: The fighters' entrance: a squat stone hut against the arena wall.
4: THE FIGHTERS' DOOR. TITHE FIGHTERS REPORT HERE. BRING YOUR OWN COURAGE.
q: A barrel of sand for the arena floor. Somebody has written HELP in it with a finger.
_: South, back down to the bazaar.

objects.name: Even Bett
lines: Bets on the ladder! Five champions, five bouts, odds chalked fresh every morning.
My cousin Odd Bett does the street brawls. I do the proper fights. We don't speak.

answer: Hroth. Hroth's always the favourite. Forty years of the shortest odds in Kaldorhold.
Between us, I've chalked you in. Very long odds. Very pretty number.

questions.ask: Why don't you speak to Odd Bett?
answer: She took bets on Durn and Haskel. Eleven days. Paid out on day seven. Day SEVEN.
A bet's a bet. You don't pay till the bread's eaten. Everybody knows that.

questions.ask: Your odds are made up, Bett.
answer: All odds are made up, love. Mine are made up carefully.
And you've just gone to forty to one. Out of spite.

objects.name: Tilda
lines: I'm Hroth! I'm the champion! You have to fall over!
BRAM: I don't want to fall over. I'm Fennick. I run away.

questions.ask: Who do you want to be?
answer: Or Lady Holler. She gets to SHOUT. Indoors.

questions.ask: Hroth would never play with you.
answer: He would! He gave me a tooth! It's not his tooth. Hob sold it to him.
BRAM: You're making her cry. She cries LOUD.

objects.name: Bram
lines: Fennick never gets hit. 'Cause he runs. I'm going to be Fennick when I grow up.

answer: I run away from Tilda. Every day. Very good practice.
Fennick runs in circles. I run in a line. I'm improving it.

questions.ask: Fennick's a coward, and so are you.
answer: * He runs away. In a line. It's quite good.

objects.name: Hob
lines: Souvenirs! Foam fists! Little cardboard Kaldors! A real tooth from a real fight!
The tooth is mine. I needed the money.

answer: Little cardboard Kaldors. People like to hold a king who can't shout at them.
Ansel Chisk says they're an insult to his statues. He buys three a week.

questions.ask: Want my tooth? Free punch included.
answer: Ooh, would you? I'm running low.
…Wait. Who's doing the punching? Because I've had enough of mine done.

lines: 1. THE TWINS UGG.  2. MATRON SORREL.  3. FENNICK THE UNBITTEN.
4. THE MASKED BRUTE (DEFINITELY NOT CAPTAIN VARGA).  5. GRAND CHAMPION HROTH.
Under the arena's outer stairs, where the children hide their wooden swords: a Heart Piece.
